annotations.title: Publish a private personal event, free (hosts)

description: Publishes a private personal event the signed-in person hosts (a quince, a birthday, a wedding, a baby shower, a graduation party), free, as the organizer dashboard's Publish does. `eventIdOrName` is the event id or its name as the host says it ("my quince"). It stays private: only guests with the guest code can open the page and add their pass. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with the page link and a `confirmToken` and publishes nothing; read it out, and only when the host says publish, call again with `confirm: true` and that token. Refusals (NOT_FOUND, NOT_OWNER, NOT_PERSONAL, ALREADY_PUBLISHED, PHONE_UNVERIFIED, NOT_SIGNED_IN, CONFIRM_INVALID) are read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which publishes nothing; true with confirmToken publishes.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the host says it.
